design.implemented: Four work shifts inherit exact noon route/guide availability. Recover stranded crew, retrieve/supply medicine, recall late callers, carry food, preserve/plant seed, or wait until dusk. Separate immutable prior snapshots and schema-4 action replay.

comparisons.send_guide: grain twice via retained ferry => 4 crates in 4 shifts. Iven stays upstream.

comparisons.setup: Same wet night; morning grain/grain/depot/supply-clinic/seed. Keep crossing.
comparisons.before: Medicine supplied late; saved seed; callers have left.
comparisons.after: Recall then plant then wait => afternoon callers contacted and seed sown. Morning late timestamp unchanged; harvest unknown.
